correctness.rationale: For fixed [x,y]=y Lie bracket of upper triangular 2x2 matrices, the full polynomial (not divided-by-two) transposed identity gives five compatible linear product coefficients at odd characteristic, ten at characteristic two. Odd associativity is i(e-i)+cs=0, a 2x2 determinant cone times affine line and count q^4+q^3-q^2. In char 2, six displayed associativity equations are sufficient: with central z^2=sz, s≠0 splits an idempotent line and gives (q-1)q²(q³+q²-q); with s=0 the two-dimensional trace-zero quotient B, a character α and a rank-one extension matrix yield q³+(2q³+q²-2q-1)q². Their sum is q^6+2q^5-q^4-q². The open strata establish dimension 6 against dimension 4 odd and extension fields give stated rational zeta functions. Fresh independently coded full basis-product checks enumerated all 1024 char2 ten-parameter tables (108 admissible) and all 243 odd F3 five-parameter tables (99 admissible); all-fields conclusion rests on the symbolic stratification.
